{{Dialogue|3rd Rebel|I've never seen this kind of technology before. What does all this stuff do?|4th Rebel|I don't have any idea!|5th Rebel|I do. It's a drive lock. They've permanently locked the sublight boosters on to one course.|attr=Rebels discuss the situation aboard the ''Kuari Princess''|src=<ref name="Riders">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref>}}
A '''drive lock''' was a device used to lock the course of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on a permanent heading. The [[Riders of the Maelstrom]] used a drive lock to lock the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] on a collision course with the [[Oasis mining colony]].
